NOTICE OF DECISION
This direct appeal of the Taxpayer’s Petition for Review of personal property
valuation on the 2024-2025 Unsecured Roll came before the State Board of Equalization
(“State Board”) for hearing on September 29, 2025.
The Department presented the State Board with a signed Stipulation from the
Taxpayer for review and approval by the State Board. The Stipulation was signed by
Taxpayer and the Department on June 10, 2025.
The parties agree to the following:
The Unsecured Roll shall be revised for the 2024-2025 tax year as follows:
Unsecured Roll: 2024 - 2025 Original Taxable Value Revised Taxable Value
Personal Property $84,300 $8,605
///
///
///

DECISION
The State Board, having considered the signed Stipulation, voted unanimously to
approve the Stipulation presented. The taxable value for the property subject to the direct
appeal for the 2024-2025 Unsecured Roll shall be revised as set forth in the Stipulation.
November
24
BY THE STATE BOARD OF EQUALIZATION this _____ day of _____________, 2025.
Shellie Hughes, Secretary
